main_text.l: Ante obitum auctoris de novo compilata, aucta

page.notes: Woodcut printer's device between the lines of the title; manuscript ink annotations (including a signature-like scribble at the lower right and at the upper left and right) and a blue paper strip and oval library stamp ("Biblioteca Nacional Roma, Vittorio Emanuele") are not transcribed. The word "illustrata" is partly obscured by ink; the initial letter reads as "il-" then "lustrata". Some letters in "Wecheli" are overlapped by the stamp.
